title: Rosalind and the Radiators
author: Wren Crane
blurb: Mara Eastwick, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
